2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function mpol_set_shared_policy_range() that allows installing an already-built memory policy over an arbitrary page range without requiring a VMA. The existing mpol_set_shared_policy() function is reimplemented as a thin wrapper to derive the range from the VMA, allowing both functions to share a single underlying path. This change addresses limitations in the current implementation that make it unusable for binding entire backing inodes from in-kernel code.
